row:
We set up this group to monitor adverts for compliance with Animal Health and Welfare laws. 

Our aim is to push for better resourcing, regulation and enforcement of those laws and to push for changes in legislation that will make our laws more effective and supportive of one another.

This channel will be used to group together Videos that are relevant to the topic of puppy farming and animal welfare in Ireland.

We want to put an end to puppy farmers and dog smuggling in Ireland
